Icon Review

Candidates only — nothing here replaces a live icon until it is approved. White page on purpose: the area outside each circle is fully transparent, so what you see outside the ring is the page itself.

What changed in the variation

  • Only the glass went translucent (50%) — the runner, the lettering, and the ring stay solid, so the page underneath emerges slightly through the glass alone.
  • The neon family swapped from magenta to turquoise — ring and runner alike — and her neon is turned up a step.
  • She is scaled up about 20%: the top of her head sits closer to the ring without touching it, and the bottom of her front toe lands flush with the top of the lettering, not overlapping it.
  • Both runner images are true circles: the colored ring is the absolute edge of the file, with full transparency outside — no square backing of any color.
  • The droplet sparkle is preserved — strong at the top left, a smaller glint at the bottom right.
